notes.title: REARVIEW MIRROR MAJOR UPDATE ON OCTOBER 10th
notes.notes:
Hello Thrill-seekers!

REARVIEW MIRROR is set to receive a major update on October 10th, introducing several new features to enhance your gameplay experience.

The new update will feature 12 chapters in total —now it contains 3 only. Apart from that, it will contain a lot of new characters, improved mechanics about morality decisions, and different endings. 

The update will also include a new UI/UX and a new soundtrack. Texts will be localized in English, Spanish, and Catalan, while voice acting will be performed in Spanish and Catalan.

Share your feedback with us, and follow us on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.

Cheers!

CUBUS GAMES TEAM
